# DriftSense Pilot: demo video script (5:00 maximum)

Every number spoken or shown comes from `results/**/*.json`, rendered into this page. Read it off this
page, never from memory. Record the live parts with `make dev-server` (no AWS needed) or the deployed
URL. The escalating site is `vsem-dram-17`; `vsem-dram-7` commits on the first look.
The v1 MunichTech script is kept in `VIDEO_SCRIPT_MUNICHTECH.md`.

| Time | Shot | Voice-over |
|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:20 | Team on camera, then a grid of identical transistors | "On a repeating array the microscope cannot tell which copy it is looking at. Measuring the wrong one silently corrupts process control." |
| 0:20–0:45 | UI result page: the NCC heatmap (many equal peaks) next to the roughness heatmap (one peak) | "Frequency tells you where a copy could be. Roughness tells you which one is real. The agent decides where to look next, and when to ask a human." |
| 0:45–1:45 | Live run of `vsem-dram-17`: the timeline rows *low SNR → double the dwell*, *margin below τ → contour re-localize* | "Each row is an OpenCV 5 measurement. The uniqueness margin is compared with τ, and that comparison picks the next action: more dwell, another rectification, a wider field of view." |
| 1:45–2:15 | The approval card: top 3 candidates, margin vs τ, Approve rank 1, then Succeeded | "When it cannot prove uniqueness within its step and dose budget, it never moves the stage. It asks an operator, and the decision goes in the audit trail." |
| 2:15–2:45 | MCP Inspector (or `python scripts/mcp_demo_client.py`) calling `acquire` twice and then `localize` | "The same six tools are exposed over MCP, so any MCP client can operate the virtual SEM. The safety gate stays in the runner." |
| 2:45–3:30 | `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` diagrams | One line per box: CloudFront UI, HTTP API on arm64 Lambda, SQS, the Graviton4 worker on the COOL AMI running the engine and agent, CloudWatch canary and alarms. |
| 3:30–4:20 | `SUBMISSION.md` result tables | See the numbers below. Say the negative results out loud. |
| 4:20–4:50 | Failure gallery (`results/sealed/v2_single_failures.png`) | "Where it fails: rotated, degraded arrays where two copies are genuinely indistinguishable in one frame." |
| 4:50–5:00 | Links | Repo, live demo, report. |
